# packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```


# temp data import

```{r temp-data-import}
templog <- read.csv(file="../../data/treatments/urban temp.csv", head=T) 
templog$Time<- lubridate::mdy_hms(templog$Time) # reformats time as month day year hours minutes seconds
templog$OA <- as.factor(templog$OA)
templog$Thermal <- as.factor(templog$Thermal)
str(templog)

temp_melt <- pivot_longer(templog, Ssid.C.C:Ofav2.L.H, names_to = "spp.ph.temp", values_to = "measurement") # reshapes dataframe to long format
temp_melt %>%
  separate(spp.ph.temp, into=c("species","ph","temp"), sep="[.]") -> temp_melt # separates species and ph/temp factors to columns

temp_melt$species <-  as.factor(temp_melt$species) 
temp_melt$ph <-  as.factor(temp_melt$ph) 
temp_melt$temp <-  as.factor(temp_melt$temp) 

temp_melt$hour <-lubridate::hour(temp_melt$Time) # creates column of simplified hour by time

# system failure, Apr 28-30 2021: loggers were offline from Apr 24 12:27 to Apr 28 23:15. When logging
# resumed, the heat-stress tanks were cooling (to ~22.7 C by Apr 29 03:00) and CO2 dosing had stopped in
# two low-pH tanks. All heat-stress tanks were back at 33 C by Apr 30 09:31. Readings in this window stay
# in the data files but are excluded from all temperature and pH summaries (tables and plots)
event_start <- lubridate::ymd_hm("2021-04-28 23:00")
event_end   <- lubridate::ymd_hm("2021-04-30 10:00")
in_event <- function(time) time >= event_start & time < event_end

# thermal periods by treatment group: the two heat-stress groups were ramped ~3 weeks apart, so the
# row-level Thermal label in the data file doesn't apply to every column. Periods are set per group:
#   control: before the first ramp (Apr 5), all tanks
#   thermal: original heat-stress tanks (temp H) from Apr 19 12:00, when 33 C was reached;
#            ambient tanks (temp C) from Apr 19 12:00 until their own ramp began (~Apr 25);
#            second heat-stress group (Ssid2/Ofav2 columns, recorded only once at 33 C) throughout
#   ramp:    everything else (ramps, and the ambient tanks' ramp Apr 28-May 10)
thermal_start <- lubridate::ymd_hm("2021-04-19 12:00")
temp_melt %>%
  mutate(period = case_when(
    Thermal == "control" ~ "control",
    str_detect(species, "2") ~ "thermal",
    temp == "H" & Time >= thermal_start ~ "thermal",
    temp == "C" & Time >= thermal_start & Time < lubridate::ymd("2021-04-25") ~ "thermal",
    TRUE ~ "ramp")) %>%
  filter(!in_event(Time)) -> temp_melt

# daily means +/- SE: loggers record every minute, so readings are averaged to daily means
# first and the SE is calculated across days (minute-level readings are not independent).
# Days with readings in fewer than 12 of 24 hours (partial days at logger gaps, tank moves and period
# boundaries) are dropped, so every daily mean represents at least half a diel cycle
min_hours <- 12
daily_summary <- function(dat, ...) {
  dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(measurement)) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(Time)) %>%
    group_by(..., date) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(lubridate::hour(Time)) >= min_hours) %>%
    summarise(daily_mean = mean(measurement), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(daily_mean), sd = sd(daily_mean), n_days = n(),
              se = sd / sqrt(n_days), .groups = "drop")
}

# hourly (diel) means +/- SD: same logic as daily_summary, but within each hour of the day.
# Readings are averaged per hour per day first, then mean and SD are calculated across days,
# so the ribbons show day-to-day variability (consistent with the treatment/tank tables)
hourly_summary <- function(dat, ...) {
  dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(measurement)) %>%
    mutate(date = as.Date(Time)) %>%
    group_by(hour, ..., date) %>%
    summarise(hourly_mean = mean(measurement), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
    summarise(avg = mean(hourly_mean), sd = sd(hourly_mean), n_days = n(),
              se = sd / sqrt(n_days), .groups = "drop")
}
```


# temp plot

```{r temp-plot}
fill.color<-c("#4393c3","#b2182b") # custom palette

temp_melt %>% # plot of temp means by hour (daily means per hour +/- SD across days)
  filter(period =="thermal") %>%
  hourly_summary(temp) %>%
  rename(avg_temp = avg) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x=hour + 0.5, y=avg_temp, color = temp)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(fill=temp, group = temp, ymin = avg_temp - sd, ymax = avg_temp + sd), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(group = temp)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = fill.color) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill.color) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 6), limits = c(0, 24)) + # hourly means plotted at the middle of each hour
  labs(x="Hour", y="Temperature (C)") -> temp_plot
plot(temp_plot)

temp_melt %>% # table of treatment means (daily means +/- SE)
  filter(period =="thermal") %>%
  daily_summary(temp) -> temp_mean
write.csv(temp_mean, file = "../../outputs/treatments/urban temp mean.csv")
```


# ph data import

```{r ph-data-import}
phlog <- read.csv(file="../../data/treatments/urban ph.csv", head=T) 
phlog$Time<- lubridate::mdy_hms(phlog$Time)
phlog$Thermal <- as.factor(phlog$Thermal)
str(phlog)

ph_melt <- pivot_longer(phlog, Ssid.C.C:Ofav.L.H, names_to = "spp.ph.temp", values_to = "measurement")
ph_melt %>%
  separate(spp.ph.temp, into=c("species","ph","temp"), sep="[.]") -> ph_melt

ph_melt$species <-  as.factor(ph_melt$species) 
ph_melt$ph <-  as.factor(ph_melt$ph) 
ph_melt$temp <-  as.factor(ph_melt$temp) 

ph_melt$hour <-lubridate::hour(ph_melt$Time)

ph_melt %>% # excludes the Apr 28-30 system failure (see temp data import)
  filter(!in_event(Time)) -> ph_melt
```


# ph plot

```{r ph-plot}
fill.color2<-c("#80cdc1","#01665e")

ph_melt %>% # table of treatment means by hour (daily means per hour +/- SD across days)
  filter(OA =="OA") %>%
  hourly_summary(ph) %>%
  rename(avg_ph = avg) -> ph_mean_hour
write.csv(ph_mean_hour, file = "../../outputs/treatments/urban ph mean hour.csv")

ph_mean_hour %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x=hour + 0.5, y=avg_ph, color = ph)) + 
  theme_classic() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(fill=ph, group = ph, ymin = avg_ph - sd, ymax = avg_ph + sd), alpha = 0.2, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(group = ph)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = fill.color2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill.color2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 24, by = 6), limits = c(0, 24)) + # hourly means plotted at the middle of each hour
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(7.7, 8.1, by = 0.1)) +
  expand_limits(y = 8.1) + # keep 8.1 on the axis
  labs(x="Hour", y="pH") -> ph_plot
plot(ph_plot)

ph_melt %>% # table of treatment means (daily means +/- SE)
  filter(OA =="OA") %>%
  daily_summary(ph) -> ph_mean
write.csv(ph_mean, file = "../../outputs/treatments/urban ph mean.csv")
```


# multi plot

```{r multi-plot}
temp_table <- ggtexttable(mutate(temp_mean, across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))), rows = NULL)

ph_table <- ggtexttable(mutate(ph_mean, across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 3))), rows = NULL)


multiplot <- ggarrange(temp_plot, ph_plot, temp_table, ph_table, heights = c(3,1))
multiplot
ggsave("../../outputs/treatments/urban tank treatments.pdf", plot = multiplot, dpi = 300, width = 8.5, height = 4)
```


# temp and pH tank means

```{r temp-and-ph-tank-means}
ph_melt %>% # pH tank means during OA
  filter(OA =="OA") %>%
  daily_summary(species, ph, temp) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_ph_OA"), c(mean, sd, n_days, se)) -> ph_mean_tank_OA

temp_melt %>% # temp tank means pre-thermal stress
  filter(period =="control") %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace(species, "Ofav2", "Ofav")) %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace(species, "Ssid2", "Ssid")) %>%
  daily_summary(species, ph, temp) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_temp_control"), c(mean, sd, n_days, se)) -> temp_mean_tank_control

temp_melt %>% # temp tank means during thermal stress
  filter(period =="thermal") %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace(species, "Ofav2", "Ofav")) %>%
  mutate(species = str_replace(species, "Ssid2", "Ssid")) %>%
  daily_summary(species, ph, temp) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_temp_thermal"), c(mean, sd, n_days, se)) -> temp_mean_tank_thermal

ph_mean_tank_OA %>% # joining all the summary stats into one table
  left_join(temp_mean_tank_control, by=c('species'='species','ph'='ph','temp'='temp')) %>%
  left_join(temp_mean_tank_thermal, by=c('species'='species','ph'='ph','temp'='temp')) -> ph_mean_tank

write.csv(ph_mean_tank, file = "../../outputs/treatments/urban tank treatment means.csv")
```
